content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Shreveport Path to CAPM Certification

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires only a secondary degree (high school diploma or equivalent) and completion of project management education—no prior work experience needed. This makes CAPM ideal for Shreveport professionals entering project management roles across healthcare, energy, manufacturing, and aerospace sectors.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Contact Hours Online
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot-camp course. Our intensive format fits working schedules, delivering the full PMI-required education without travel. You'll learn from active certified practitioners in real time, with direct access to answer questions throughout.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your course, submit your PMI application and pay the exam fee directly to PMI. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the application process to ensure your credentials are documented correctly and your eligibility is confirmed.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the CAPM Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy supports your exam readiness with study materials, practice questions, and guidance on test-day logistics. The computer-based exam is offered year-round at testing centers; we'll help you schedule and approach it with confidence.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: CAPM is valid for three years. Earn professional development units (PDUs) through continuing education, volunteer work, or professional activities to renew. Staying current keeps your credential competitive in Shreveport's growing project management market.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
